hooks.command: cmd=$(jq -r '.tool_input.command // ""' | tr '\n' ';'); printf '%s' "$cmd" | grep -Eq '(^|[;&|(])[[:space:]]*(sudo[[:space:]]+)?docker([[:space:]]|$)' && { printf "Blocked: this session runs INSIDE the dev container - there is no docker CLI and never will be. Reach services over the compose network by name (proxy:8080, api:8000, db:5432), or run the tool directly.\n" >&2; exit 2; }; exit 0

cmd=$(jq -r '.tool_input.command // ""' | tr '\n' ' '); printf '%s' "$cmd" | grep -Eq '\.sh([[:space:]]|"|$)|(^|[;&|(])[[:space:]]*(sh|bash|zsh|dash|ksh)[[:space:]]+[^-]' && { printf "Blocked: never write a shell script and execute it. Run the documented command directly with the Bash tool.\n" >&2; exit 2; }; exit 0

f=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // ""'); case "$f" in */.claude/hooks/*.sh) exit 0;; *.sh|*.bash|*.zsh) printf "Blocked: do not create shell scripts. Run the command directly with the Bash tool.\n" >&2; exit 2;; esac; exit 0

root=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null) || exit 0
cd "$root" || exit 0
PC=$(command -v pre-commit) || { printf "pre-commit not found on PATH\n" >&2; exit 1; }
list=$( { git diff --name-only HEAD; git ls-files --others --exclude-standard; } | sort -u )
[ -n "$list" ] || exit 0
oldIFS=$IFS
IFS="
"
set --
for f in $list; do
  set -- "$@" "$f"
done
IFS=$oldIFS
idx=$(mktemp) || exit 0
cp "$(git rev-parse --git-path index)" "$idx" || exit 0
export GIT_INDEX_FILE="$idx"
"$PC" run --files "$@" >/dev/null 2>&1 || { out=$("$PC" run --files "$@" 2>&1) || { rm -f "$idx"; printf "%s\n" "$out" >&2; exit 2; }; }
rm -f "$idx"
